comment: A session whose model the provider refuses: both turns FAILED. Shape taken from a live agentlab session on kagent 0.9.12 (ids shortened, error text verbatim): history holds only the user's message — twice, under one messageId, as kagent always repeats it — and no agent reply at all; the reason lives solely on status.message, an agent-role message whose messageId appears nowhere in history. artifacts is null and the status message carries no metadata, so it contributes no token usage.
